subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` option for envelope and system-event display dates, and if so what enum and scope should be supported?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config fields and this changes model-visible prompt text rather than fixing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Approve narrow display-only field
options.body: Add an ISO-default `dateFormat` option limited to human-readable envelope and system-event dates, with machine timestamps and filenames left ISO.

options.title: Keep ISO-only
options.body: Document that prompt-visible timestamps intentionally remain ISO for sorting and model clarity, leaving locale-specific rendering to downstream clients.

options.title: Defer to broader time contract
options.body: Hold this until related temporal-grounding issues settle a single prompt/display timestamp policy across envelopes, system events, heartbeat, and memory surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow display-only field
recommendation.body: Add an ISO-default `dateFormat` option limited to human-readable envelope and system-event dates, with machine timestamps and filenames left ISO.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to the existing envelope config surface and docs history introduced in the inbound-envelope configurability work.
